title: Vexos Platform Manager (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vexos Platform Manager (Remote) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built. We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ About The Render Pros / VEXOS We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ The Role The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported. You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ✅ What You'll Be Responsible For - Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM - Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials - Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person - Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date - Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track - Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed - Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ What We're Looking For Experience - 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role - Experience working with SaaS platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus - Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement Skills - Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily - Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly - Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users - Highly organized with strong attention to detail - Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure - Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift Mindset - You follow through. Every time.
- You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated - You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients - You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

title: Senior Workday Financials Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Workday Financials Consultant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the job As a Senior Workday Financials Consultant at Aspire, you will support the Finance Solution Delivery team in configuring, maintaining, and enhancing Workday Financials. You will work across multiple financial domains, handling both production support and project-based work, while partnering with Finance stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable solutions. This role requires strong autonomy, problem-solving skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, lean team environment. What you’ll do Provide hands-on configuration, support, and maintenance across multiple Workday Financials domains. Act as a flexible “utility player,” supporting priority areas based on business needs. Troubleshoot and resolve production issues and system defects in a timely manner. Design and implement scalable Workday Financials solutions aligned with long-term platform health. Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into system configurations. Support ongoing enhancements, optimizations, and process improvements within Workday Financials. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of financial system changes. Contribute to backlog reduction and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders. Ensure solutions are well-designed, maintainable, and aligned with best practices. What you’ll need 5+ years of hands-on experience with Workday Financials. Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday. Experience supporting both production support and project-based implementations. Ability to work independently in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Strong problem-solving and systems thinking skills. Proven experience across multiple Financials domains, especially: Financial Accounting (top priority), Expenses, Business Assets, Banking & Settlement (secondary) Experience with Workday Accounting Center and/or Prism is a plus. Familiarity with Workday integrations and reporting is a plus. Exposure to Workday Orchestrations or automation frameworks is a plus. Strong communication skills with the ability to engage directly with business stakeholders. Experience working in lean, high-performing teams with broad ownership responsibilities.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role: We are modernizing the applications and processes that power all US pricing and revenue management. As a Senior Backend Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and building the next generation of these systems, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and future‑proof. This is primarily a backend engineering position, with opportunities to grow into frontend and full‑stack development over time. Your Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python (preferably FastAPI ) to support pricing and revenue management use cases. Collaborate closely with product, data, and revenue management teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. Design and optimize relational database schemas, queries, and data models using SQL and Azure SQL (or similar). Contribute to the architecture and system design of distributed services, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance. Implement and improve observability and tracing to monitor system health and troubleshoot issues effectively. Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and best‑practice definition within the engineering team. Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes, tooling, and automation. Your Profile Must‑have: 7–10 years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with a strong focus on backend development. Strong proficiency in Python and modern backend frameworks, ideally FastAPI. Solid experience with SQL and relational databases (schema design, query optimization, data modeling). Strong engineering fundamentals and system design skills, including experience with distributed systems and tracing/observability. Languages:Portuguese: Native / Mother tongue English: Fluent (written and spoken) Nice to have: Experience with event‑driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka and Azure Service Bus. Familiarity with containerization and orchestration, especially Kubernetes. Experience working in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure. Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within our workforce and creating an inclusive work environment. To this end, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic.

Domínio avançado do ecossistema Databricks (incluindo Unity Catalog, Delta Tables, Databricks Workflows/Jobs);
Fortes conhecimentos em frameworks de validação de dados (ex: Great Expectations ou Delta Expectations);
Sólida experiência comMLflow para gerenciamento do ciclo de vida de modelos e linhagem de features.(;
Experiência prática com estratégias de versionamento de dados e histórico (SCD Tipo 2 / Tipo 4);
Proficiência em Pythonvoltado para desenvolvimento de pacotes, classes reutilizáveis e testes unitários independentes;
Conhecimento em conceitos de governança de dados (Metadados, Catálogo, Linhagem, Controle de Acesso). Diferenciais: Experiência prévia na implementação de Feature Stores do zero (ex: Feast, Databricks Feature Store);

Conhecimento da metodologia/lógica de negócio modular E-A-C-TIM.

title: Especialista Técnico Sap I
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Técnico Sap I em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Responsabilidades e atribuições Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP. Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes. Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis. Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time. Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP. Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas. Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto. Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações\ "Z\" tradicionais em favor deextensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes. Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance. Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna. Requisitos e qualificações Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem. Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+;
Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views. Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform). Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes. Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban. #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Machine Learning Engineer Sênior com forte experiência em Databricks e MLflow para liderar a construção de uma nova Feature Store corporativa, atuando com arquitetura, governança, qualidade e escalabilidade para projetos de Machine Learning. Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto Principais Responsabilidades: Desenvolvimento de Framework Core: Desenvolver componentes modulares e reutilizáveis (Writer, Data Quality, Feature Functions) baseados em boas práticas de engenharia de software, evitando os famosos\ "Spaghetti Notebooks\";
Garantia de Qualidade e Auditoria: Implementar motores de validação de dados (Data Quality) integrados a ferramentas como Great Expectations ou Delta Expectations, criando lógica de\ "Gatekeeper\" para bloquear dados inconsistentes;
Modelagem e Persistência Histórica: Desenvolver lógicas avançadas de persistência de dados históricos, incluindo SCD Tipo 2 e Tipo 4, garantindo consistência temporal completa (Point-in-Time Correctness via as-of join);
Governança e Linhagem: Estruturar o registro de metadados de negócio e técnicos no Unity Catalog (Feature Registry), garantindo consistência semântica e rastreabilidade total integrando com MLflow (FeatureLookup);
Orquestração eDevOps de Dados: Configurar e orquestrar pipelines de dados complexos e atômicos no Databricks, gerenciando de forma eficiente ambientes (Dev/Prod) e políticas de versionamento/release;
Foco no Usuário (Discovery & UX): Realizar rodadas de alinhamento com Cientistas de Dados para coletar feedbacks, ajustar escopos técnicos e garantir que a usabilidade da Feature Store atenda às reais necessidades do time de negócios;
Disseminação de Conhecimento: Liderar a migração de projetos piloto, criar documentações no estilo Self-Service (\ "Como criar minha primeira Feature\ ") e ministrar workshops práticos (Hands-on) para capacitar o time de Ciência de Dados. Requisitos: Experiência sólida e comprovada atuando como Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior ou Engenheiro(a) de Machine Learning;
Domínio avançado do ecossistema Databricks (incluindo Unity Catalog, Delta Tables, Databricks Workflows/Jobs);
Fortes conhecimentos em frameworks de validação de dados (ex: Great Expectations ou Delta Expectations);
Sólida experiência comMLflow para gerenciamento do ciclo de vida de modelos e linhagem de features.(;
Experiência prática com estratégias de versionamento de dados e histórico (SCD Tipo 2 / Tipo 4);
Proficiência em Pythonvoltado para desenvolvimento de pacotes, classes reutilizáveis e testes unitários independentes;
Conhecimento em conceitos de governança de dados (Metadados, Catálogo, Linhagem, Controle de Acesso). Diferenciais: Experiência prévia na implementação de Feature Stores do zero (ex: Feast, Databricks Feature Store);
Familiaridade com taxonomias de transformações complexas (MIT, MDT, ODT);
Conhecimento da metodologia/lógica de negócio modular E-A-C-TIM.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Andela At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America. As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster. Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI. Join us and change the world. Role Overview We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / AI) to help build and scale the next generation of applications for one of our growing enterprise clients. This is a senior-level engineering role with a strong backend focus, combining modern full-stack development with AI-powered application development. You will be responsible for architecting and building scalable systems, establishing development standards, integrating Generative AI solutions into production environments, and driving technical decisions across multiple initiatives. The role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, enjoys building systems from scratch, and can operate as a highly autonomous technical leader while collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders. Exceptional Leadership As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you. Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea. One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone. Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve — our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen. Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you. Player-coach: You fly high and low. You understand the strategy while staying close to the details that matter. You roll up your sleeves, stay hands-on, and empower others without micromanaging. Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert;
you approach your workthrough the lens of solving business problems. Key Responsibilities Backend Architecture & Development Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems using .NET and C#. Architect robust APIs, services, and application infrastructure that support current and future products. Establish engineering standards, best practices, and maintainable system architectures. Drive technical decisions that improve scalability, reliability, security, and performance. Full-Stack Development Collaborate with frontend teams working in React to deliver end-to-end application functionality. Contribute across the full stack when needed while maintaining a strong backend focus. Ensure seamless integration between frontend experiences and backend services. Support application modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. AI & Generative AI Integration Design and implement Generative AI solutions within production applications. Evaluate and integrate LLM-powered capabilities that improve business processes and operational efficiency. Build AI-enabled workflows, automation systems, and intelligent application features. Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business value. Technical Leadership & Solution Design Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across projects. Make informed technology decisions in environments with evolving requirements and limited structure. Lead solution design discussions and identify the best approaches for implementation. Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views. Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform). title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:

About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do. We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives. You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil What you'll need 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems Great organisational and time management skills Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks Solid analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Fluency in English Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

This is a senior-level engineering role with a strong backend focus, combining modern full-stack development with AI-powered application development. You will be responsible for architecting and building scalable systems, establishing development standards, integrating Generative AI solutions into production environments, and driving technical decisions across multiple initiatives. The role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, enjoys building systems from scratch, and can operate as a highly autonomous technical leader while collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders. Exceptional Leadership As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you. Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea. One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone. Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve — our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen. Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you. Player-coach: You fly high and low. You understand the strategy while staying close to the details that matter. You roll up your sleeves, stay hands-on, and empower others without micromanaging. Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert;
you approach your workthrough the lens of solving business problems. Key Responsibilities Backend Architecture & Development Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems using .NET and C#. Architect robust APIs, services, and application infrastructure that support current and future products. Establish engineering standards, best practices, and maintainable system architectures. Drive technical decisions that improve scalability, reliability, security, and performance. Full-Stack Development Collaborate with frontend teams working in React to deliver end-to-end application functionality. Contribute across the full stack when needed while maintaining a strong backend focus. Ensure seamless integration between frontend experiences and backend services. Support application modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. AI & Generative AI Integration Design and implement Generative AI solutions within production applications. Evaluate and integrate LLM-powered capabilities that improve business processes and operational efficiency. Build AI-enabled workflows, automation systems, and intelligent application features. Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business value. Technical Leadership & Solution Design Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across projects. Make informed technology decisions in environments with evolving requirements and limited structure. Lead solution design discussions and identify the best approaches for implementation. Drive engineering excellence through mentorship, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Collaboration & Delivery Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Partner with leadership to align technical strategy with business goals. Participate in planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery activities. Ensure solutions are delivered with high quality and maintainability. Qualifications & Competencies Experience 8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend development. Extensive hands-on experience with .NET and C#. Strong full-stack development experience with modern web application architectures. Experience building and deploying production-grade applications. Experience working in startup, scale-up, or high-growth environments. AI & Modern Engineering Proven experience integrating Generative AI solutions into production applications. Hands-on experience working with LLMs, AI-powered workflows, or intelligent automation systems. Understanding of AI orchestration patterns, agentic workflows, or AI application architecture. Experience evaluating and implementing emerging AI technologies. Technical Expertise Strong knowledge of software architecture, system design, APIs, and distributed systems. Experience designing scalable and maintainable backend services. Deep understanding of modern development practices, testing strategies, and deployment workflows. Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities. Leadership & Communication Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills. Ability to operate independently and make high-impact technical decisions. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing priorities. Strong ownership mentality and accountability for outcomes. Nice to Have Experience with Claude and AI orchestration frameworks. Experience with AI agents, RAG architectures, or advanced LLM implementation patterns. Experience building products or platforms from scratch. Experience leading technical teams or serving as a technical lead. Experience working in highly autonomous engineering environments. What We’re Looking For We're looking for someone who is more than a software developer. The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who can own technical outcomes, architect scalable solutions, integrate AI into real-world products, and operate with minimal oversight. You should be comfortable making architectural decisions, solving complex backend challenges, collaborating across functions, and leveraging AI technologies to create business impact. This role is best suited for someone who is highly autonomous, technically strong, product-minded, and excited about building the future of AI-enabled software systems. Role Details Location : Remote (LATAM / Americas) Time Zone : Must maintain a minimum of 6 hours overlap with US working hours Contract Type : Contracting Duration : 12 Months Expected Start Date : 22 June 2026 Assessment Path : .NET Required Technologies : .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, Generative AI Apply Now Apply now to join Andela's global talent network and support the development of next-generation AI-powered applications for a fast-growing technology-driven organization. This is an excellent opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Backend Engineer who enjoys modern architecture, AI-powered development, technical leadership, and building scalable systems from the ground up.

title: Analista De Negócios Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Negócios Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados. Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização. Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura. Principais responsabilidades Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros). Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos. Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto. Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros. Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização. Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação. Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas. Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados. Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics. Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares). Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação. Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares). Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva. Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações). Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais). Diferenciais Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer). Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP). Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega. Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas. Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven. Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK). Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares). Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

O que é importante para o perfil: Desejo de crescer na sua carreira Desejo de sempre aprender novas habilidades Desejo de sempre melhorar suas técnicas Sempre está se capacitando sobre o tema vendas Desenvolve Skills de comunicação, relação interpessoal e inteligência emocional Experiência: Mínimo de 30 vendas no período de 90 dias. title: Electrical/Electronic Engineering Analyst (R&D)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Electrical/Electronic Engineering Analyst (R&D) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description: We are seeking an Electrical\ Electronic Engineering analyst to join our R&D team. This role will work with project design, product development, product and components validation testing, testing of electrical and electronic software-controlled systems for new products and current products improvement, ensuring seamless transition from concept to production. The professional will collaborate with suppliers, manufacturing, cost reductions initiatives, and multifunctional teams to deliver high-quality, reliable, and cost-competitive products. Responsibilities: Develop and refine the design of electrical\ Electronic components to support scalable and efficient product manufacturing. Collaborate closely with headquarters' R&D, suppliers to develop and qualify electrical components, ensuring alignment with production requirements. Provide technical support to manufacturing processes related to electrical and electronic components, facilitating smooth and efficient production. Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on optimizing product quality and cost, ensuring product reliability, cost competitiveness, and customer satisfaction. Analyze and support the resolution of electrical issues encountered both on the production line and in the field. Electrical Components Technology Research, develop features according to the habits and needs of Brazilian users. Perform electrical testing, validation, and troubleshooting to guarantee compliance with safety standards and technical specifications. Create and maintain detailed technical documentation, including schematics, test procedures, and reports. Work closely with multifunctional teams - including mechanical, software, quality, and manufacturing - to integrate electrical systems effectively. Liaise with suppliers and external partners to source components and resolve technical challenges. Software features development for the Brazilian market, including developing innovative functions based on local user needs and modifying control software for different product models. Electrical control software technology research, developing software functions and control strategies tailored to the habits and needs of Brazilian users. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field. Experience in electrical design, testing, and manufacturing support within an R&D environment. Proficiency with electrical design software (e.G., CAD, simulation tools) and testing equipment. Strong knowledge of electrical safety standards and product certification processes. Analytical and proactive mindset with strong problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Willingness to travel as necessary. Differentials: Experience in the home appliance, durable goods industries. Knowledge of embedded systems and firmware development. Familiarity with manufacturing processes and supplier management. Advanced English proficiency.

Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. Certificadode Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);
Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo. title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis. Responsibilities: Manage large amounts of incoming tickets. Provide support to answer inquiries on products. Accept and handle technical requests. Triage tickets to the other teams. Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies. Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools. Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication. Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits;
follow up to ensure resolution. Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents. Take the extra mile to engage customers. Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager. Skills And Qualifications: A Bachelor’s degree completed 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support or customer success roles Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English. Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion. Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics. Attention to detail is key to this position. Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs. Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills. Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce). Why Join JoVE? A competitive compensation package. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Retention Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us? About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota. What You’ll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Engenheiro De Ia Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Ia Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção. Esta não é uma vaga de\ "treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\ ". E engenharia de plataformacom foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção. O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter: - Orquestrador: Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update.
- Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert): cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade.
- Rules: Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent.
- Recovery loops: quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota.
- Multi-repo via submodules: projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar.
- Stack: Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.Js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações HTTP com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy. O que você vai fazer Manutenção do core (40%) - Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática.
- Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário.
- Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento.
- Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue).
- Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta\ "agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\ ", \"deploy não promoveu\") efechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva. Evolução de agents e rules (35%) - Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist).
- Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho.
- Manter o agent-authority.Md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146).
- Criar/refatorar skills.
- Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B). Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%) - Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct).
- Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação).
- Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve.
- Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient;
expandir cobertura).
- Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria. O que esperamos de você Stack técnica — obrigatório - Bash/Shell avançado e Linux — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.Sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de (( e porque importa.
- Node.Js / TypeScript — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS).
- Git e GitHub avançado — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows.
- Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que\ "diga ao modelo o que não fazer\ " raramente funciona, entendeo efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está\ "alucinando\" um PR que não criou. Experiência - 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção.
- Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs em ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre\ "rodou no demo\" e \"rodou emprod 24/7 sem humano\ ".
- Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer\ "reescrever do zero\".
- Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios;
comunicação verbal podeser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time). Mentalidade - Determinismo >
magia. Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável.
- Forensics sobre intuição. Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese.
- Documentação executável. Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI.\ "Documentei em texto\" não basta.
- Empatia por agente. Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar. Diferenciais - Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes.
- Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker em integrações com APIs externas instáveis.
- Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs.
- Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent frameworks).
- Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves.

A empresa participa regularmente de feiras internacionais de eletrônicos todos os anos (nos Estados Unidos, Alemanha, Vietnã e Brasil). 6. capacidade de respostarápida e perspicaz;
forte senso de responsabilidade. 4. Experiência em técnicas e estratégias de vendas, incluindo habilidades de apresentação e negociação. 5. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria. Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde. Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Certificado deTítulo de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo ;
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes. Competências Comportamentais: Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina. IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia. Responsabilidades: Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos. Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados. Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance. Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh. Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). O que você encontra aqui: Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. description:

Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B) About Sisense Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action. The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance. Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense’s growth in embedded AI analytics. About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning. Requirements 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions. How You’ll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team’s revenue retention and growth goals. What We Offer Employment through a partner agency (B2B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.
